details:
Marketing API v25.0 is available until 2027-02-23 (Graph API v25.0 itself runs to 2028). After that, ads calls pinned to v25.0 fail or are auto-upgraded, and endpoints that changed in v26.0 fail. Meta also says the explicit targeting_automation.advantage_audience flag becomes mandatory on all versions once v25.0 is deprecated.

Upgrade Marketing API calls to v26.0, set targeting_automation.advantage_audience to 1 or 0 explicitly on ad set targeting, and review the v26.0 changelog (poll ads, Messenger Stories, Explore placement, delivery estimate fields) before 2027-02-23.
